question: What is the average fastest lap time in seconds for Lewis Hamilton in all the Formula_1 races?
evidence: average fastest lap time = avg(fastestLapTime); The time is recorded on 'MM:SS.mmm'
clarification: Also keep rows that have no matching results record.
gold: SELECT AVG(CAST(SUBSTRING(T2.fastestLapTime, 1, INSTR(T2.fastestLapTime, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60 + CAST(SUBSTRING(T2.fastestLapTime, INSTR(T2.fastestLapTime, ':') + 1) AS REAL)) FROM drivers AS T1 LEFT JOIN results AS T2 ON T1.driverId = T2.driverId WHERE T1.surname = 'Hamilton' AND T1.forename = 'Lewis'
gold0: SELECT AVG(CAST(SUBSTR(T2.fastestLapTime, 1, INSTR(T2.fastestLapTime, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60 + CAST(SUBSTR(T2.fastestLapTime, INSTR(T2.fastestLapTime, ':') + 1) AS REAL)) FROM drivers AS T1 INNER JOIN results AS T2 ON T1.driverId = T2.driverId WHERE T1.surname = 'Hamilton' AND T1.forename = 'Lewis'

d.request: What is Lewis Hamilton’s average fastest lap time in seconds across all Formula_1 races, including races with no matching results record?
d.sql: SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN res.fastestLapTime IS NOT NULL AND instr(res.fastestLapTime, ':') > 0 THEN CAST(substr(res.fastestLapTime, 1, instr(res.fastestLapTime, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 60 + CAST(substr(res.fastestLapTime, instr(res.fastestLapTime, ':') + 1) AS REAL) ELSE 0 END) AS average_fastest_lap_seconds FROM races AS r LEFT JOIN results AS res ON res.raceId = r.raceId AND res.driverId = (SELECT driverId FROM drivers WHERE forename = 'Lewis' AND surname = 'Hamilton' LIMIT 1)

c.request:
What is the average fastest lap time in seconds for Lewis Hamilton in all the Formula_1 races?
Evidence: average fastest lap time = avg(fastestLapTime); The time is recorded on 'MM:SS.mmm'
Also keep rows that have no matching results record.
c.sql: SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN instr(res.fastestLapTime, ':') > 0 THEN CAST(substr(res.fastestLapTime, 1, instr(res.fastestLapTime, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 60 + CAST(substr(res.fastestLapTime, instr(res.fastestLapTime, ':') + 1) AS REAL) END) AS average_fastest_lap_seconds FROM races AS r CROSS JOIN drivers AS d LEFT JOIN results AS res ON res.raceId = r.raceId AND res.driverId = d.driverId WHERE d.forename = 'Lewis' AND d.surname = 'Hamilton'

b.request: Across all Formula 1 races, calculate the average of Lewis Hamilton’s recorded fastest lap times after converting them from MM:SS.mmm to seconds, retaining races with no matching results record
b.sql: SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN res.fastestLapTime LIKE '%:%' THEN CAST(substr(res.fastestLapTime, 1, instr(res.fastestLapTime, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 60 + CAST(substr(res.fastestLapTime, instr(res.fastestLapTime, ':') + 1) AS REAL) END) AS average_fastest_lap_seconds FROM races AS r LEFT JOIN results AS res ON res.raceId = r.raceId AND res.driverId IN (SELECT driverId FROM drivers WHERE forename = 'Lewis' AND surname = 'Hamilton');
